description: This file defines the interface CommandConsumerFactory, a factory for creating command consumers and response senders for the Eclipse Hono project. It contains methods for creating command consumers with various configurations and obtaining command response senders, including legacy support.

classes.name: CommandConsumerFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating command consumers and response senders in the Eclipse Hono client.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a CommandConsumerFactory given a connection and gateway mapper.

methods.name: createCommandConsumer
methods.description: Creates a command consumer for a device, with multiple overloads for different configurations, including gateway association and liveness checks.

methods.name: getCommandResponseSender
methods.description: Returns a sender for command responses for a given tenant and reply ID.

methods.name: getLegacyCommandResponseSender
methods.description: Returns a sender using the legacy address pattern; deprecated in favor of getCommandResponseSender.
